input: Request a LinkedIn skills endorsement from a colleague

gold.taskTitle: Request a LinkedIn Skills Endorsement from a Colleague
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to reach out to a colleague and ask them to endorse specific skills on their LinkedIn profile.

questions.title: Which specific colleague are you planning to ask?
questions.description: Identify the colleague by name, role, or relationship to personalize the request.

questions.title: Which LinkedIn skill or skills do you want endorsed?
questions.description: Pinpoint the exact skill(s) listed on the profile that the user wants the colleague to endorse.

questions.title: How well does this colleague know your work directly?
questions.description: Understand the depth of the professional relationship to gauge how credible and comfortable the endorsement request will be.

questions.title: What channel will you use to send the request?
questions.description: Determine whether the request will go via LinkedIn message, email, phone, or in person.

questions.title: Have you endorsed this colleague on LinkedIn already?
questions.description: Check whether a reciprocal endorsement has been made, which can make the ask feel more natural.

questions.title: Is there a deadline by which you need this endorsement?
questions.description: Establish any time pressure, such as a job application or profile update, to prioritize the task correctly.

questions.title: Do you want to write the message yourself or need help drafting it?
questions.description: Determine whether the user needs assistance composing the outreach message or plans to write it independently.
